stories.title: Why the Army says it needs to detonate unstable, lead-filled explosives in Iowa and what's at risk
stories.summary: A federal court indefinitely suspended the U.S. Army's plans to detonate 68 drums of lead azide in Iowa after communities raised concerns.

stories.title: No. 14 Oregon routs Michigan State 45-7
stories.summary: Brandon Smith set career highs with 121 yards and two touchdowns, kicker Gage Hurych ran for a 15-yard scored on a fake field goal and No. 14 Oregon routed Michigan State 45-7 to hold onto hopes of earning a spot in the College Football Playoff.

stories.title: Scottie Barnes scores 29 as Raptors end skid with 105-102 win over Pistons
stories.summary: Scottie Barnes scored 29 points, including a crucial layup, as the Toronto Raptors snap their six-game losing streak with a 105-102 victory over the Detroit Pistons in an NBA Cup game.

stories.title: Child shot with unsecured gun on Detroit's west side, police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a 5-year-old was shot with an unsecured gun Friday on Detroit's west side.

stories.title: Thousands gather for annual Tree Lighting ceremony in Detroit
stories.summary: Thousands of people traveled to downtown Detroit for the annual Christmas Tree Lighting ceremony on Friday. While families enjoyed the event, law enforcement officials and community leaders worked to make sure people were safe.

stories.title: Investigation continues after 5-year-old shot with unsecured gun in Detroit
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a 5-year-old was shot with an unsecured gun Friday on Detroit's west side.

stories.title: Police investigate alleged online threat against Hamtramck High School, suspect in custody
stories.summary: One person was taken into custody in connection with an alleged social media threat against Hamtramck High School.

stories.title: Royal Oak staff member on administrative leave over alleged threat toward students, officials say
stories.summary: School officials did not provide details on the alleged threat, but said the staff member is not allowed on school property.

stories.title: Lead azide detonation in Iowa by U.S. Army paused indefinitely after lawsuits are filed
stories.summary: The U.S. Army's plan to detonate five tons of unstable explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa has been put on indefinite hold by a federal court Friday.

stories.title: Child critically hurt after being shot with unsecured gun, Detroit police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a 5-year-old was shot with an unsecured gun Friday on Detroit's west side.

stories.title: Two men charged in separate Oakland County human trafficking cases involving woman, minors
stories.summary: Demonte Thompson, 23, and Paul Dilisio, 59, are both facing multiple felonies after the Oakland County Sheriff's Office said an investigation into Thompson led to evidence against Dilisio.

stories.title: Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer talks working with Trump, her time in office
stories.summary: "Call me in January," Whitmer said when asked what she thinks of Mr. Trump. As she reaches the end of her time in office, Whitmer talked about her time in the state's top job.
